label: Behavior verified
formula: 100 * current-task obligations whose reducer completion is evidenced / all approved current-task obligations, snapshot. Also counts by evidenced/failed/blocked/not_run/stale
missing: Before A: draft counts only, no approved ratio. Accepted gaps stay in denominator; regression excluded and counted separately

label: Critical behavior verified
formula: T01 restricted to P0/P1 plan priority; show n and priority breakdown
missing: Unknown priority is a separate gap; it cannot be treated as noncritical

label: Test outcomes
formula: Unique current instances per pass/fail/error/blocked/skipped/not_run/stale/ambiguous, per task/level/repo/owner. Preserve source statuses; no fabricated conversion of broken_run to test failure
missing: Missing report means not_run/unknown per existing reducer, never zero failures = pass

label: Test pyramid
formula: Counts and percentages of T03 instances by recorded level, with separate unknown/ambiguous and manual lanes; all outcomes included
missing: Unknown level remains in total and its own lane; no removal from denominator

label: Manual proof completeness
formula: 100 * approved manual-agent cases whose current accepted outcome includes all required evidence / approved manual-agent cases. Show failed-with-proof separately from passed-with-proof
missing: manual-human cases shown pending separately; missing evidence is not a pass

label: Open obligations and regression
formula: Counts by kind/status and age; list recommended_regression checks explicitly 'not run by factory'
missing: No scope registry -> unavailable; empty valid registry -> 0

label: Bug snapshot
formula: Count unique bugs by severity/status; draft and published badges. Open statuses use adapter mapping, default local Open/Fixed/Reopened/Blocked/Intended, closed local Verified/Closed/Rejected/Duplicate
missing: Unknown status in separate bucket. Inventory scope label always visible; no bugs in partial export is not project-wide zero

label: Area defect weight
formula: Sum weights of unique known bugs per area, weights 8/5/3/1 unless configured. Display highest ceil(share*number_of_areas) areas sorted by weight then name; default share 0.5
missing: Unknown severity count shown but excluded from weighted sum; missing area grouped Unknown. Label weighted count, not density

label: Bug age
formula: max(0, as_of-created_at) days for each open bug; severity then descending age ordering
missing: Missing/invalid date: age unavailable for that bug, row retained

label: Bug flow
formula: Unique bugs created within window; unique bugs entering terminal closed state within window; separately transition counts if a bug closes more than once
missing: Closed count requires transition evidence; current closed snapshot alone is insufficient

label: Rejected-bug cohort rate
formula: 100 * window-created bugs whose current disposition is Rejected / all window-created bugs. Explicit cohort-as-of label
missing: Duplicate separate, not rejected. Missing disposition for cohort -> partial lower bound with known denominator

label: Reopen rate
formula: 100 * unique bugs with Fixed->Reopened transition in window / unique bugs entering Fixed or leaving Fixed to Reopened in window
missing: Requires complete transitions over window for cohort. Otherwise unavailable, not count-based guess

label: Time to first fix
formula: Median (first Fixed timestamp-created_at)/86400 for bugs whose first Fixed occurs in window; group by priority/area; n always visible
missing: Need complete origin/first-fix evidence. Eligible excluded rows make result partial with included/eligible counts

label: Repeated status cycles
formula: Count/list bugs with >=2 verified reopen transitions in available complete history; disclose history start
missing: Legacy trusted reopen_count can be shown as imported total, not mixed with window rate. Discussion 'ping-pong' unavailable unless explicit structured dispute events exist; no LLM reading discussions for this metric

label: First-attempt pass rate
formula: 100 * instances whose first conclusive behavioral attempt in each task+fingerprint passes / instances with a first conclusive pass/fail attempt; window by attempt timestamp
missing: Execution errors/unknown results shown separately; incomplete attempt history -> unavailable or explicitly partial cohort

label: Current pass rate
formula: 100 * current passing instances / all approved selected automated instances, snapshot
missing: Pending/stale/skipped stay in denominator; not a quality certification

label: Flaky evidence rate
formula: 100 * unique task+instance+fingerprint with both pass and fail conclusive attempts / such identities with >=1 conclusive attempt in window. Require unchanged code/test/runtime/data-seed contract and allowed repeated-attempt provenance
missing: No automatic reruns to populate rate. Show repeated-sample count; unverified equivalent inputs cannot establish flaky

label: Retry rescue
formula: Count identities with fail then pass under same fingerprint; divide by identities with failed first conclusive attempt for rescue percentage
missing: Fix changing fingerprint is repair, not rescue. Missing ordering -> unknown

label: Unexplained failure rate
formula: 100 * conclusive failed attempts not associated with a valid red_lock bug / conclusive behavioral attempts; window
missing: Report red-locked failures separately, never hide them; unknown lock linkage yields partial attribution

label: Automation risk coverage
formula: 100 * P0/P1 current-task obligations with accepted sufficient automated assertion links / all P0/P1 current-task obligations. Design metric, separate from executed T02
missing: No area-level % inferred from arbitrary area names. Missing design assessment -> partial or uncovered, never sufficient

label: Run duration and volume
formula: Job count; sum of actual ended-started execution seconds; median completed job seconds; unique instances and new/updated/reused tests by accepted lifecycle action
missing: Imported results show imported counts; missing duration excluded with n. Sum job time may exceed elapsed wall time under parallelism; label explicitly

label: Test health
formula: Unique quarantined cases, active red_lock cases, open DEBT, past explicit sla_due debt. Snapshot
missing: No synthetic SLA from removed config. Missing full store inventory means known counts, not suite-wide clean

label: Duplicate execution
formula: Count local behavioral attempts re-executing already-current passing instance/fingerprint with no invalidation and purpose initial/repair_verify; share of local behavioral attempts
missing: Allowed flaky_diagnostic/diagnostic and red proofs excluded and shown separately; this metric observes duplicates, never authorizes them

label: Reused evidence
formula: Unique selected instances satisfied by imported or earlier fresh receipt without a new local launch / all selected automated instances, snapshot
missing: Reused receipt does not count as new run or extra saved hours automatically

label: Findings and DD
formula: Counts by open/closed state and FB scope; open-item age days and weeks=days/7; due flags only explicit typed triggers
missing: Missing/corrupt canonical registry -> unavailable, not 'no findings'; disclosed legacy fallback only when canonical absent

label: Rejects by role
formula: Count unique rejected handoffs, group by role/reason; rejection rate = rejected handoffs / accepted+rejected handoffs within window
missing: Incomplete journal coverage -> known count/partial rate; retry dispatch alone is not rejection

label: Blocked/unsafe handoffs
formula: Separate counts of gate_block and unsafe_completion events
missing: Neither absence of journal nor unknown event mapping yields zero. Rewrite obsolete tooltip promising break-glass success; do not change acceptance mechanics

label: Long dispatches
formula: Number of role dispatches with >80 recorded model requests; show actual counts and max; orchestrator sessions listed separately
missing: Threshold is informational, not turns.soft and not hard budget. Partial usage shows 'at least'; no quadratic-cost certainty in tooltip

label: Retries
formula: Controller dispatches with parent_retry as a share of all dispatches, split by the cause the parent recorded when it stopped (retry_reason)
missing: No unstructured journal inference. A dispatch with no recorded cause is classified from its parent, never dropped

label: Blockers and lifecycle
formula: Count/list active blocked/paused/halted tasks, stage, next action and exact reason; current revision
missing: Controller is authority; do not infer success from artifact presence

label: Projection/evidence health
formula: Count stale projections and missing proof/version links identified by existing validator; show revision and diagnostic
missing: Renderer failure is distinct from product failure; no repair rerun

label: Orchestrator shares
formula: Token share=100*orchestrator tokens/all tokens; cost share=100*orchestrator valued USD/all valued USD; distinct labels/trends
missing: Cost share only with complete comparable valuation; token share can remain available with unknown prices

label: Orchestrator share over the limit
formula: Stories whose orchestrator cost share exceeds retro.orchestrator_share_max (default 0.35), each with its share, the limit and the per-stage split of the orchestrator's own priced requests placed by that story's stage clock
missing: A story with no orchestrator receipts, or one whose spend is a floor, is missing and never a zero share; a stage whose clock runs backwards places nothing and leaves those requests unattributed

label: Tokens
formula: Sum mutually exclusive normalized categories, grouped by activity/task, role, exact model, UTC request day
missing: Partial usage explicitly marked; no synthetic usage

label: Estimated USD
formula: Sum over requests/categories of tokens * applicable rate / 1e6; group as C01
missing: Missing price -> known subtotal and missing counts; never total label. Unconfirmed default rate still computes with label

label: Reconciliation
formula: Compare activity sum, role sum, model sum with same request-set total; exact tokens, USD tolerance 0.000001 before display rounding
missing: complete equal -> matched; known unequal -> mismatch; incomplete -> unknown. Partial mismatch of provably identical complete subsets may be separately diagnosed

label: Human wait
formula: Sum nonnegative time the story waited for a person: each answered question put to the person (tool call to its result, uncapped) plus each gap from completed assistant response to following human input within activity (capped, cost.human_wait_cap_s=1800; the part inside a question counted once). Stage machine time = stage wall time minus the waits inside the stage window, never below 0
missing: No time evidence -> unavailable; a capture that did not measure question waits -> named floor and no machine time; an open question has no known length; label turn gaps capped estimate, not billable compute

label: Activity time
formula: Sum min(adjacent main-chain request time gap,120s) within each uninterrupted activity segment; also capped-wall total with 1800s cap in details
missing: Fewer than two timestamps -> no_data; never bridge across doctor/story segment boundaries; not exact machine time

label: Requests/tools/rework
formula: Requests and tool calls by role/type; rework USD=sum costs attributed to dispatches explicitly linked parent_retry or repair purpose; percent over complete total. Relation to the retro (retro_numbers.dispatch_rounds): the retro counts a repair round only for a re-dispatch of the same (stage, role) scope that is NOT a continuation (retry_reason checkpoint/compaction/turn_budget/subagent_silent/no_digest_at_exit/host_error, contract.CONTINUATION_RETRY_REASONS); C06 counts every parent_retry link, so C06 rework >= the retro's repair-round cost
missing: Do not classify by prose name 'fix'; unknown dispatch-purpose leaves attribution partial

label: Time to first test
formula: Earliest actual behavioral execution start - verified S0 start for task, seconds; exclude red probes/build/collection
missing: No execution yet -> pending; imported-only -> not_applicable; missing start -> unavailable

label: Tokenomics band hit
formula: 100 * completed, fully priced tasks whose cost in inclusive [lo,hi] / completed fully priced tasks with valid final size
missing: S9 complete but session cost provisional -> show provisional dot, exclude from finalized rate. No size or full price -> excluded count

label: Band vs actual
formula: For each size show preserved band and median complete task USD, with n
missing: Display actual groups only once real X records exist; no filled-in demo rows for missing groups

label: Cost drift
formula: Median((actual_usd-upper_band)/upper_band) over C08 population, %
missing: No eligible tasks -> no_data

label: MMRE and PRED(25)
formula: MMRE=mean(abs(actual-upper_band)/actual); PRED25=100*count(error<=0.25)/n. Label upper-band benchmark, not an individualized forecast
missing: actual=0 excluded from these two ratios with reason; C08 still includes it

label: Estimate revisions
formula: Counts of (size_initial,size_final) pairs per distinct completed task; same values counted unchanged; include final revision only
missing: Missing size pair -> excluded count

label: Divergence drivers
formula: Count completed tasks with each distinct recorded driver label, sorted descending then label. Share=tasks with driver/tasks with >=1 driver; multi-label sum can exceed 100%
missing: Do not infer causal labels from cost. No drivers -> unavailable

label: Automation time benefit
formula: Potential manual hours avoided=sum baseline_manual_minutes for distinct eligible successful routine automated executions /60. Net hours=avoided-verified automation authoring hours-maintenance hours
missing: Exclude red probes, diagnostics, repair retries and imported duplicate receipts. No baseline/effort -> unavailable; never assume gap-based time is human effort. Label modeled benefit, not measured savings

label: Monetary ROI
formula: (documented comparable counterfactual USD - complete actual total USD)/actual total USD; actual total includes model, infra and human costs without mixing hours and USD
missing: No approved baseline or labor/infra inputs -> unavailable with exact missing fields. actual=0 -> undefined, not infinite. Never monetize found bugs using arbitrary severity weights
